title: UN Comtrade — Pacific Member Merchandise Trade
description: Bilateral merchandise trade by HS commodity for Samoa, Fiji, Tonga, Vanuatu, PNG, Solomon Islands and Kiribati.
notes: Most complete commodity-level trade source. Comtrade terms of use restrict bulk redistribution — needs human licence review before any resale. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: World Bank WITS — Pacific Trade and Tariff Profiles
description: World Integrated Trade Solution country trade profiles and tariff data for Pacific Island economies.
notes: Aggregates Comtrade, TRAINS and WTO data; rights follow each underlying source, so not CLEAR. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: World Bank WDI — Exports of Goods and Services (% of GDP), Pacific Islands
description: World Development Indicators trade-openness series for Pacific Island countries.
notes: WDI is published under CC BY 4.0. Attribution must also name the national source the World Bank cites (Decision 59). URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: Pacific Trade Invest — Export Market Reports
description: Pacific Islands Forum trade promotion agency market reports and export statistics.
notes: Exporter-facing intelligence, mostly PDF reports — good test of document extraction. No reuse licence stated. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: Pacific Data Hub .Stat — International Merchandise Trade Statistics
description: SPC-curated international merchandise trade statistics for Pacific Island countries and territories.
notes: Regionally curated alternative to Comtrade. Licence varies by dataflow; not confirmed for this one. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.
